visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight black hair stands in front of a wooden wardrobe, wearing a pale green ribbed tank top and a gold chain necklace. She looks directly at the camera with a slight smile, touching the sides of her head near her temples. (2) She uses a fine-toothed red comb to brush her bangs forward over her eyes. Her expression is focused as she prepares her hair for styling. (3) She pulls the main part of her hair back and upwards, securing it at the crown of her head with a large black clip, leaving only the bangs and side strands loose. (4) Using a small, dark-colored grooming brush, she carefully separates and brushes a thin section of hair on the left side of her forehead near her eyebrow. (5) She holds a pair of red-handled scissors horizontally and carefully trims the ends of the small section of hair she just brushed. (6) She repeats the process on the other side, using the scissors to precisely snip the ends of the side bangs while looking intently at her reflection in the lens. (7) She brings a thick section of hair from the center of her bangs forward and trims it straight across with the red scissors, focusing on achieving a specific length above her eyes. (8) A top-down shot shows the top of her head where the hair is parted in a distinct heart shape, revealing the roots and the precision of the parting. (9) The woman appears again with her hair down and styled, smiling brightly. She poses by putting her hands behind her head, then brings them to her face to frame it with finger hearts and peace signs, showing off the completed fringe look.
